stops.title: Hour labels follow the chosen zone
stops.summary: The usage chart labelled hourly periods with the UTC hour. It now converts the period start to wall time in the selected zone and formats it with `hour_label`, so a 12-hour preference reads `3 PM` instead of `15:00`.

attention.note: `hour_label` is shared with the tooltip. Check that both still agree on midnight, which the old code printed as `00:00`.

excerpts.caption: The period start becomes wall time before it is labelled.

notes.title: Zone conversion
notes.body: `m.zone` is the zone picked in the header, not the machine's.

questions: Does the tooltip use the same zone as the axis?
What happens to a period that starts on a daylight saving change?

stops.title: Register the pages module
stops.summary: A new `pages` module holds the sidebar footer's utility pages. It only declares the two pages and imports what their key handlers need.

stops.title: Route the page
stops.summary: `Route::PullRequests` replaces the main column, the way `Route::Usage` opens over it.
